title: A Pascoa Original: O Que Jesus MUDOU na Antiga Festa?
description:
A Páscoa, conforme instituída em Êxodo 12, celebrava a libertação do Egito com o sacrifício do cordeiro e o sangue nas portas. No entanto, o ritual evoluiu para um evento centralizado no Templo, com milhares de sacrifícios e um intenso simbolismo. Jesus, ao instituir a Nova Aliança, ressignificou radicalmente os elementos da Páscoa, apontando para uma libertação ainda mais profunda.

#shorts #pascoa #historiabiblica #misteriosbiblicos

title: The Passover Meal: Eaten in Breathless TERROR
description:
Exodus chapter 12 details a Passover meal consumed under immense tension, with each item serving a brutally practical purpose for immediate flight. The biblical account describes a hurried preparation, yet the full extent of the impending terror is left for the morning.

description:

title: Passover: The Reclining Transformation
description:
The original Passover, as commanded in Exodus 12, prescribed a meal eaten standing, in haste, prepared for immediate departure. Yet, by the first century CE, the Jewish tradition had transformed this sacred observance to one of reclining at the table.
